description: The official mark-scheme rows for one part of an exam.now past paper: each row's code (M1, A1, B1…), marks, answer, guidance and alternatives, the part's maximum marks, the paper's general marking principles, the mark-scheme PDF page and a link to it on exam.now.

include_principles.description: Include the paper's general marking principles.

paper_id.description: exam.now paper id from find_past_paper, e.g. 0580_s24_42 (syllabus code, series letter s/w/m and two-digit year, component).

part.description: Part id as the paper numbers it, e.g. "3", "3(a)" or "3(a)(i)".

name: get_mark_scheme
title: Get a mark scheme
